purpose: ONE bounded common-clock prospectively registered system research programme, exactly two economically distinct cross-market premises and three fixed target groups; not independent confirmation or historical model rehabilitation.

source.executionOutcomePrice: exact source M5 close only; historical fills unknown
source.sourceCost: 166 original authenticated development current-term BID/ASK/currency/margin contexts; missing never zero

families.economicPremise: A completed rise in gold as haven demand can precede near-term yen appreciation (USDJPY falling), with a fixed inverse sign of the last gold H1 change; opposite gold move predicts USDJPY rising. This tests commodity haven transmission rather than previously closed index-to-FX impulse, oil-to-CAD, currency relative ranking, or London fixing.
families.benchmark: same-clock target USDJPY own-last-H1 momentum and zero trade

families.economicPremise: A broad prior H1 USD appreciation may represent global funding tightening that negatively leads US equity indices. USD strength is fixed USD-aligned consensus of EURUSD GBPUSD AUDUSD USDCAD; >=3 of 4 aligned signs are needed; short indices on strong USD, long on weak USD. Reverse causal direction of old index-to-FX transmission; not its model or a historical ablation.
families.benchmark: same-clock each target's last-H1 own momentum and zero trade

clock.features: completed exact t and t-60m source M5 closes, no imputation; no fitted coefficients or thresholds beyond fixed sign majority

scientific.pilot: development-only signed mechanism outcomes and weekly BLOCK strategy and incremental benchmark variances (including zero-signal weeks), never unconditional all-long proxy; no selection response inspected if gate fails
scientific.mde: Bonferroni normal approximation using dependence-aware calendar week clusters; must be <=1.25x original adverse proxy cost bps for each group, not a general power certificate
scientific.multipleComparisonPolicy: all 3 target groups and 6 one-sided tests disclosed; no winner rescue or parameter tuning
scientific.scoring: conditional gross, central, adverse, matched benchmark; weekly one-sided Bonferroni lower if pilot passes; separately report all missing marks
scientific.stop: missing source/cost/contract, any power gate failure, no positive adjusted adverse and incremental selection lower: exact group closes without inverse/rescore

finance.minMarginSource: original authentic current expected margin for target minimum volumes; simultaneous static sum only a necessary condition
finance.requiredNativePath: OpportunityOrchestrator and NativeFundedLedger C# for any future candidate funding; never Python isolated wallet
